name: forge-local
description: Self-hosted AI coding assistant for local and private language models

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @forge/server" "npm run dev -w @forge/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @forge/web && npm run build -w @forge/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @forge/server && npm run test -w @forge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @forge/server && npm run typecheck -w @forge/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
